__comment: angle_cobweb_1, flipped to gather at the FLOOR. Identical geometry: both elements already span the full cell height, so the only thing putting the web at the ceiling is the texture. The strand's uv has its v coordinates swapped, which mirrors it vertically. Doing it in uv rather than as a model rotation is deliberate -- blockstates only rotate about x and y, and an x:180 flip would also move the sheet to the opposite face of the cell, changing which wall it belongs to. The web sheet is NOT flipped: cobweb.png is a dense full-cell web with no top/bottom bias.
